classification.difficultyReason: Use tangent-radius perpendicularity to select Pythagoras and trigonometric ratios, separating radii from external segments.

content.prompt: Find the values of x, y and θ correct to two decimal places, where tangents are drawn at S and T.

spec.description: Circle centre O; O,A,B collinear in that order, OT radius5 and tangent TB12. OA=x, AB=y, angle TBO=theta. No added right-angle mark.
spec.answerVisibility: Original supplied givens and targets only; no derived numerical values or proof conclusions.

answer.worked:
Since OA and OT are radii, $x=5$. Radius OT is perpendicular to tangent TB.
$$\begin{align*}OB&=\sqrt{5^2+12^2}=13\\y&=AB=13-5=8\\\tan\theta&=\frac5{12}\\\theta&\approx22.62^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: External point P with tangents PS/PT and radii OS/OT. O,A,P collinear; OA4, AP8; PS=x.
spec.answerVisibility: Original supplied givens and targets only; no derived numerical values or proof conclusions.

answer.worked:
The radius is $4$, and $OP=OA+AP=4+8=12$. Since OS is perpendicular to PS,
$$\begin{align*}x^2&=12^2-4^2=128\\x&=\sqrt{128}\approx11.31.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Tangent BT horizontal, radius OT7; B,A,O collinear. Angle OBT20degrees, BT=x, BA=y.
spec.answerVisibility: Original supplied givens and targets only; no derived numerical values or proof conclusions.

answer.worked:
Radius OT is perpendicular to tangent BT.
$$\begin{align*}\tan20^\circ&=\frac7x\\x&=\frac7{\tan20^\circ}\approx19.23\\OB&=\frac7{\sin20^\circ}\\y&=OB-OA=\frac7{\sin20^\circ}-7\approx13.47.\end{align*}$$
